# Pause & Pass

> Pause & Pass is a white-label rider-attention safety plugin for shared micromobility operators (e-scooters, self-propelled bicycles, e-bikes, e-mopeds). When an active trip approaches a mapped high-risk crossing, it triggers a configurable audio-safety intervention (pause, duck, chime or in-app prompt) and logs an auditable event. No vehicle hardware, no separate rider app; runs inside the operator's existing rider app.

## What it is
- A software-only safety layer that operators embed in their existing rider app.
- Reduces avoidable audio distraction (headphones/music) before a rider enters a pre-mapped high-risk location such as a railway crossing or complex intersection.
- Complementary to fleet geofencing, computer vision and collision-alert systems — an add-on, not a replacement.

## Who it is for
- Shared micromobility fleets (e-scooters, self-propelled bicycles, e-bikes, e-mopeds) with an app-based trip flow.
- Multi-city and cross-border operators wanting one safety layer across markets.
- Safety-forward and enterprise platforms with insurance and regulatory exposure.

## How it works
1. Trip starts: the rider opens the operator app and starts a trip as usual; the plugin activates in the background for that active trip.
2. Zone: on-device logic evaluates the mapped zone, movement and location confidence, then requests the operator's configured audio intervention within device/OS capabilities.
3. Cleared: normal audio behaviour resumes and a privacy-minimised event (zone ID, timestamp, app/SDK version, outcome) is logged to the operator dashboard.

## Key facts
- Platforms: Android first, built with the operator during the pilot; iOS scope agreed per pilot.
- Interventions are configurable: pause, duck, chime or in-app prompt.
- No vehicle hardware required; software only.
- Produces an auditable event log for permit, regulator and insurer discussions.
- Transparency: operators control rider disclosure; recommended privacy language provided (GDPR-aware).
- Data: on-device zone evaluation; only minimised events reach the backend; hosting region stated in the DPA; retention agreed per operator.
- Pricing: paid pilot (EUR 5,000-7,500, one city, 8-12 weeks), then per active ride (roughly EUR 0.005-0.008 depending on volume, with a monthly minimum).
- Coverage: eligible active trips on supported app versions and devices.

## Market context (Latvia)
- OCTA insurance is mandatory for e-scooters since 1 July 2025 and for self-propelled bicycles since 1 May 2026 (LTAB).
- Pause & Pass is not an insurance product and does not guarantee lower premiums; it creates preventive controls and measurable safety evidence that may support future claims and insurance-risk discussions.

## Pilot
- One city, 20-30 high-risk zones, 8-12 weeks, integrated in the operator's existing app.
- Measured: trips in risk zones, interventions triggered, technical coverage, false activations, missed interventions, team readiness.

## Honest limitations
- Audio behaviour is not guaranteed identical across every OS, device and player; behaviour is validated per supported matrix.
- Zone-detection accuracy depends on device GPS and conditions; configurable buffers and location-confidence rules reduce false triggers.
- The product does not by itself guarantee accident reduction, regulatory compliance or lower insurance premiums; it provides evidence and safety interventions to support those goals.

## Company
- A product of DAGAR Ltd. Built in the Baltics (Riga-first), expanding across Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania.
